Get JTBD segment comparison: ordinal

Source: R/segmentation.R
get_jtbd_segment.comp.ordinal.Rd

Calculates ordinal (rank-based) comparisons between segments, including rank deltas, percent-of-max scores, and significance levels.

Usage

get_jtbd_segment.comp.ordinal(your_df)

Arguments

your_df

A data frame in long format containing JTBD scores

Value

A data frame with ordinal comparison metrics

See also

Other segmentation: get_jtbd_scores.batch(), get_jtbd_scores.comparison(), get_jtbd_scores.pairwise(), get_jtbd_var_values.list(), get_seg_comp.build.linear(), test_segment_significance()
